tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// 'byung bzhi'i cho ga dag byed bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs// sangs rgyas rigs mchog rnam bzhi'i bsdus pa'i mgron// rigs mthun rdzas kyis so sor mchod byas pas// lus can 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i nad gdon bgegs// zhi byed brgyud ldan gdams pa'i bdud rtsi spel// pha dam pas mdzad pa'i 'byung bzhi'i gtor ma glud dang bcas pa gtang ba la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni nyer spyod bdun dang*/ sder ma sogs lo grangs kyi gtor ma shong ba'i snod bzhi dang*/ glud gtor bsham pa'i theb gcig rnams su rim pa bzhin/ zla gam la ril bu lnga/ gru gsum la ril bu gsum/ zlum po la ril bu drug gru bzhi la ril bu bzhi rnams dang*/ tha mar mi gzugs chang bu mtheb kyu bcas dang*/ yang snod yangs pa zhig tu glud gzugs che ba glud gos ting lo dang bcas pa rnams sta gon bya/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ mchod pa rnams la dmigs te/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i mchod yon zhabs bsil sogs nas/ shab+da swā hā zhes dang*/ dril bu'am ting shags brdung zhing dharma ra ṇi lan gsum gyis byin dbab/ thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ skyabs mchog sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*// grub pa'i dbang phyug dam pa sangs rgyas dang*// mkhas pa ka ma shi lar bcas pa la// sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// zhes skyabs 'gro lan gsum/ 'byung bzhi 'khrugs pa'i nad dang sdug bsngal gyis// gtses pa'i 'gro rnams bde la dgod pa'i phyir// 'khor 'das 'byung bzhi'i mgron rigs mnyes pa'i phyir// mchod sbyin gtor ma'i rim par 'jug par bya// zhes pa lan gsum gyis sems bskyed la/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du rang nyid skad cig gis sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo rgya gar dam pa sangs rgyas sku mdog smug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas seng ldeng gi ḍā ma ru 'khrol zhing*/

g.yon dngul dkar gyi dril bu gsil ba/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan cing dar dmar po'i na bza' can/ rten 'brel gyi gal ta phrag pa la bkal ba/ ā li kā li'i sgra don thugs su chud pa/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos kyi dgongs pa thugs la gsal zhing*/ brgyud pa kun gyi gdams pa ma lus pa 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rigs bzhir gtogs pa'i rgyal ba yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes dang*/ ma lus sems can sogs sh+lau ka gsum gyi mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra e h+ya his spyan drangs/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa sogs sh+lau ka gcig dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ga ga na sa ma ya hūm̐ zhes dang*/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ bdag dang 'gro la sogs nas pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ zhes pas gdan 'bul lo// de nas mdun du bshams pa'i gtor ma la dmigs te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ baṃ las chu/ laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pa can te/ 'byung bzhi so so'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la/ zla gam la/ oṃ yaṃ tsa tsha dza dzha nya sha yaṃ i ī o au swā hā/ lnga'am nyer lnga bzlas pas phul te/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod nas/ rlung rdzas las grub pa'i mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di/ mi bskyod pas gtso byas pa'i rdo rje'i rigs kyi yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la 'bul lo// yongs su bzhes nas bdag dang sbyin bdag gi gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi nad rlung las gyur pa/ gdon dri za dang rgyal 'gong nyon mongs pa zhe sdang nye bar zhi nas 'byung ba bzhi cha snyoms pa dang*/

snang ba rten 'brel du 'char zhing rten 'brel gyis 'gro don dpag tu med pa nus par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces dang*/ gru gsum la/ oṃ raṃ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa ṣa raṃ ṛ ṝ e ai swā hā/ gsum mam nyer gsum sogs bzlas/ ar+ghaṃ sogs/ me rdzas las grub pa'i mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis gtso byas pa'i rin po che'i rigs kyi yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la 'bul lo// yongs su bzhes nas bdag dang sbyin bdag gi gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi nad tshad pa las gyur pa/ gdon grul bum dang btsan bdud pho gdon nyon mongs pa nga rgyal dang ser sna nye bar zhi nas 'byung ba bzhi cha snyoms pa dang*/ snang ba rten 'brel du 'char zhing rten 'brel gyis 'gro don dpag tu med pa nus par byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes dang*/ zlum po la/ oṃ waṃ pa pha ba bha ma ny+pa waṃ u ū swā hā/ drug gam nyer drug sogs bzlas/ ar+ghaṃ sogs/ chu rdzas las grub pa'i mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di/ 'od dpag med kyis gtso byas pa'i pad+ma'i rigs kyi yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la 'bul lo// yongs su bzhes nas bdag dang sbyin bdag gi gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi nad grang ba las gyur pa/ gdon klu rigs dang mo gdon nyon mongs pa 'dod chags nye bar zhi nas 'byung ba bzhi cha snyoms pa dang*/ snang ba rten 'brel du 'char zhing rten 'brel gyis 'gro don dpag tu med pa nus par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes dang*/ gru bzhi la/ oṃ laṃ ta tha da dha na sa laṃ l̥ l̥̄ swā hā/ bzhi'am nyer bzhi sogs kyis dbul/ ar+ghaṃ sogs/ sa rdzas las grub pa'i mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di/ don yod grub pas gtso byas pa'i las kyi rigs kyi yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la 'bul lo// yongs su bzhes nas bdag dang sbyin bdag gi gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi nad bad kan las gyur pa/

gdon gnod sbyin dang sa gdon nyon mongs pa phrag dog dang gti mug nye bar zhi nas 'byung ba bzhi cha snyoms pa dang*/ snang ba rten 'brel du 'char zhing rten 'brel gyis 'gro don dpag tu med pa nus par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab bo// de nas hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya dang*/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi྾ chos kyi྾ dge 'dun gyi྾ gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo khro mo rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyi brlabs kyis sbyin pa'i bdag po che ge mo 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i nad bdag yams bdag lan chags bu lon sha 'khon gnyer ba'i gdon bgegs kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad skad cig thang cig yud tsam la 'dir mchis par gyur cig oṃ ṭā ki hūm̐ dzaḥzhes pa dang po'i tshe lan gsum gyis dgug ste/ glud byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du glud gtor 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐/ gsum mam bdun brjod/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang sogs bzhi la phyag 'tshal te/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma gzugs glud chang bu dang bcas pa 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di/ nad bdag yams bdag dal bdag sha ser mig ser gyi bdag mo/ bad kan glang thabs kyi bdag mo/ 'brum bu dang g.yan pa'i bdag mo/ rgyu gzer khrag 'dzag gi bdag mo 'khor dang bcas pa la sogs pa 'byung ba bzhi'i phyogs ris su gtogs pa thams cad la ster ro// 'jig rten gyi khams su nad yams dang dal yams ma gtong bar/ mi nad sna dgu dang phyugs nad spun dgu thams cad med cing mi 'byung bar mdzod cig

nad pa'i ched du gtang tshe/ khyad par sbyin pa'i bdag po che ge 'di la/ tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du bu lon lan chags kyi mgron du gyur pa/ phan btags drin gyi lan chags/ mdza' ba grogs kyi lan chags/ pha ma bu tsha'i lan chags/ rigs rus gnyen gyi lan chags/ gnod byas 'khon pa'i lan chags/ bsad pa srog gi lan chags/ 'phrog bcom nor gyi lan chags/ rta phyugs bkol spyad lan chags/ keg dang sri langs lan chags/ rmi ltas mtshan ngan gyi lan chags la sogs pa bu lon lan chags ma khyer ba thams cad 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rin chen gzugs glud gtor ma chang bu dang bcas pa 'di dag bu lon lan chags sha 'khon thams cad byang zhing dag pa'i ched du bzhes la/ bzung ba thong la bcings pa khrol cig sbyin bdag 'khor bcas zla ba sgra gcan las grol ba ltar bde bar 'tsho bar gyur cig ces brjod la/ glud che ba yod pa'i snod du mgo mjug ma log par bzhag go /de lta bu nad pa'i lo grangs sam brgya rtsa bsags na/ sngar gyi snod rnams su zla gam sogs re re dang*/ mtheb kyu'am zan ril re bcas bsnan la/ byin gyis brlabs la lo grangs bar bsngo/ ha cang lo mang ba la de ltar ma nus na/ zla gam sogs bcu bcu bsnan pa la byin rlabs dang sngags nyer lnga sogs bzla bas bsngo zhing 'bul yang btub gsungs pas long skabs dang bstun no// 'di nad pa sogs la shin tu phan che bar myong bas grub gsung zhing*/ de'ang brtsig lugs ni/ zla gam gru gsum sogs rang rang gi dbyibs su brtsig gsungs pa ltar bya/ de ltar lo grangs sogs ji ltar 'dod pa btang zin pa dang*/ de nas glud rnams nad pa'i lo bdud sogs kyi steng du bskyal ba'i sngon du 'di skad brjod do// kye srid pa gsum gyi lha dang klu// gdon bgegs 'byung po su yang rung*// bu lon lan chags don gnyer rigs// tshur shog rgyal ba'i bka' la nyon// 'bru mchog ngar glud ya mtshan can// phyi ltar 'byung ba dar zab gos// nang ltar rin chen 'dod dgu'i rdzas// gsang ba ye shes lnga'i bdud rtsi// ngar glud gtor rdzas phun tshogs 'di// sngon tshe lha dbang brgya byin glud// da lta rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas glud// glud bdag thams cad glud long la// yas bdag thams cad yas bzhes shig

/bdag cag rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas kyi// sha yi glud 'di sa la gtong*// sa la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams// glud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la// 'khor 'dir gnod pa ma byed cig /sham bu kun la sbyor/ khrag gi glud 'di chu la྾ /chu la gnas pa'i྾ /glud dang gtor ma྾ /'khor 'dir gnod pa྾ /drod kyi glud 'di me la྾ /me la gnas pa'i྾ /glud dang gtor ma྾ /'khor 'dir gnod pa྾ /dbugs kyi glud 'di rlung la྾ /rlung la gnas pa'i྾ /glud dang gtor ma྾ /'khor 'dir gnod pa྾ /sems kyi glud 'di mkha' la྾ /mkha' la gnas pa'i྾ /glud dang gtor ma྾ /'khor 'dir gnod pa྾ /rus pa'i glud 'di rdo la྾ /rdo la gnas pa'i྾ /glud dang gtor ma྾ /'khor 'dir gnod pa྾ /pags pa'i glud 'di thang la྾ /thang la gnas pa'i྾ /glud dang gtor ma྾ /'khor 'dir gnod pa྾ /skra yi glud 'di shing la྾ /shing la gnas pa'i྾ /glud dang gtor ma྾ /'khor 'dir gnod pa ma byed cig /mchog gsum bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*// da lta rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas kyi// bsam pa rnam par dag pa dang*// lhag bsam dag pas bshams pa yi// mchod sbyin glud gtor 'di bzhes la// khram la babs na khram kha phyis// sho la babs na sho de gtor// rtsis la babs na rtsis las phyungs// rgyan la babs na rgyan de spos// bzung ba thong la bcings pa khrol// bdud kyi zhags pa slar bsgyur cig /bdag dang yon bdag 'khor bcas kyi// 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi bar mdzod// chos kyi sbyin pa ni/ chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung*// zhes pa nas/ sdug bsngal kun las de grol lo// zhes dang*/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// zhes pa nas/ 'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye// zhes dang*/ rgyan gyis brgyan par byas kyang chos spyod cing*// zhes sogs nas/ gdon rnams rang gi gnas su dengs// zhes dang*/ oṃ sarba bigh+nan gats+tsha/ na maḥs man+ta sogs nas/ an+ta ka ra ya swā hā zhes brjod la/

glud rnams nad pa'i lo bdud phyogs su bskyal ba dang mnyam du gdon bgegs rnams rang gnas su song bar bsam/ zla gam shar/ gru gsum lho/ zlum po nub/ gru bzhi byang gi sa gtsang sar bskyal lo// gsum pa rjes ni/ mchod yul rnams la thal mo sbyar la/ rgyal ba rigs bzhi'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod don zhus la/ yig brgya lan gsum gyi mthar/ mchod pa'i yo byad ma 'byor nyams pa dang*// bdag blo rmongs pa ting 'dzin mi gsal sogs// thugs dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa ci bgyis pa// mchod yul rnams kyis bzod par mdzad du gsol// zhes nongs pa bshags la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad sogs kyis mthar/ badz+ra muḥ mchod yul thams cad rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam mo// dge ba bsngo ba ni/ mchod sbyin rgya chen gyur pa 'di yi mthus// tshogs gnyis mthar phyin sangs rgyas 'grub gyur nas// sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis ma bsgral ba'i// skye bo'i tshogs rnams bdag gis sgrol bar shog /sems can nad pa ji snyed sogs/ sman rnams mthu dang ldan pa sogs bsngo ba smon lam dang*/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o// smras pa/ rigs bzhi khams bzhi'i mnga' bdag rgyal ba dang*// yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong 'byung gdon bcas// rang rang mthun pa'i rdzas kyis mchod byas pas// 'byung 'khrugs 'gro ba'i bro nad sel ba'i thabs// dam pa sangs rgyas srol 'dzin yi ge'i rlung*// tha dad mos blo'i sa gzhir 'bab pa rnams// yid dpyod lha yi drang srong lto bar brgyud// yid ches go bde'i dag byed bdud rtsi skyugs// dge bas bdag kyang thams cad mkhyen thob pa// de srid skye bar dal 'byor rten ldan zhing*// phyi nang rig pa'i gtsug lag yongs bzung nas// chos dang sems can phan pa'i byed por shog

/ces 'byung bzhi'i cho ga dag byed bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba 'di ni don gnyer rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ mkhan chen bud+dha lak+ṣ+mīs mdzad pa'i sil gtor skabs su bsdus tsam mdzad pa la yig rnying rnams kyi 'gros mtshungs cung zad dang*/ ngag 'don du byed pa la med du mi rung ba'i kha 'gengs gsar bskrun bcas te/ ngag dbang tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas rab byung 'dod pa'i chu 'brug gi bgrang gzhi shar bar dpal lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa ka l+yāṇa bha wan+tu// // ༄༅// bar do'i gtor ma cha lnga pa'i nyams su blang bde'i ngag 'don rin chen gsal sgron zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// mchod sbyin cho ga'i rnal 'byor la brten nas// bar dor 'phyan pa'i sems can rnams kyi rgyud// tshogs spel bgegs zhi re ba rdzogs bya'i phyir// gtor ma cha lnga'i lag len gsal bar 'dri// 'dir bar do la ched du bsngags pa gtor ma cha lnga pa gtong bar 'dod na/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ nyer spyod bdun dang*/ cog zlum gsum dang zan ril bcu tshan gnyis bsham/ gong gi gtor ma gsum ma 'byor na de'i tshab tu zan ril byas kyang chog brgya rtsa sogs dang ma 'brel ba'i tshe/ gnyis pa ni/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon sogs nas/ shab+da ting shags brdung zhing dharma ra ṇi lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs lan gsum dang*/ oṃ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma lha'i bdud rtsi kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod/

de nas rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bor bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ zhes pas gdan phul/ saṃ bha ra nyer gcig dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ zhes pa nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ ting shags dang*/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog chos dkon mchog dge 'dun dkon mchog dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo// che ge mos gtso byas pa'i srid pa bar dor gnas pa'i sems can rnams bar do la bar do ngo shes/ bar do'i 'khrul snang thams cad lam du longs nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gtor ma gnyis pa 'bru gsum gyis byin rlabs sngar ltar las/ slar yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas kun rig rnam par snang mdzad dang rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar sngar bzhin spyan drangs la gdan phul/ 'di nyid bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po kun rig rnam par snang mdzad dang rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa la sogs ngan song thams cad sbyong ba'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo// che ges gtso byas pa'i bar do na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs nas/ bar do'i 'jigs skrag dang ngan song gi skye gnas las bsgral te bde ba can la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnam par dag par skye bar mdzad du gsol/

gsum pa byin rlabs sngar ltar las/ slar yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas gur mgon lcam dral gdong bzhi ldan pa sogs bstan srung 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs la gdan phul/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ gtsang rigs mgon po bdun bcu rtsa lnga la sogs pa dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma'i tshogs rnams la 'bul lo// che ge mos gtso byas pa'i bar do na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad la 'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi/ nyam nga ba'i g.yang sa gsum/ ma nges pa'i rtags drug la sogs pa bar do'i 'jigs skrag 'khrul snang thams cad mi 'byung zhing bsrung ba'i phrin las rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ bzhi pa 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ slar yang hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang sogs nas/ khro bo khro mo rnams kyi bden pa dang bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis che ges gtso byas pa'i bar dor gnas pa'i sems can thams cad sbyin pa'i mgron du skad cig nyid du mchis par gyur cig oṃ ṭā ki hūm̐ dzaḥzhes pas bkug la/ saṃ bha ra bdun dang de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod de/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di nyid che ges gtso byas pa'i bar do na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad kyis tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas lan chags kyi mgron bu lon ma khyer ba dang gson gyi dus su tshe gnas pa la bar du gcod pa dang*/ gshin gyi dus su sdig pa sbyong ba la bar gcod byed pa'i gnod byed kyi tshogs rnams la sbyin no// thams cad kyang gtor ma 'dis tshim nas deng phyin chad lan chags thams cad byang bu lon thams cad khyer ba dang re ba thams cad rdzogs par gyur cig lnga pa'ang byin gyis brlabs nas/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas rang bzhin du gyur pa 'di nyid che ges gtso byas srid pa bar do na gnas pa rnams la sbyin no// so so'i dbang po lnga'i spyod yul du 'dod pa'i yon tan zad mi shes par 'byung zhing rang rang so so'i bsam pa dang mthun par longs spyod par gyur cig

bar do'i 'jigs skrag 'khrul snang nyam nga ba thams cad dang bral nas bar do la bar do ngo shes bar dor lam mngon du gyur bar do longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig ces dang*/ chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung sogs nas/ 'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye zhes pa'i bar gyis chos sbyin bya/ gal te tshar grangs su btang na/ cog gsum la mtheb kyu sab/ zan ril tshar re bzhin dor/ byin rlabs sngar ltar dang*/ spyan 'dren dang dgug gzhug rnams dor ba 'di'i bar nyams su blang ngo*// gsum pa ni/ ma 'byor pa sogs kyis nongs pa bshags la/ oṃ badz+ra muḥs ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gnas su gshegs/ mchod sbyin gnas 'dir gang lhags pa// gtor ma dang ni mchod sbyin gyis// tshim zhing mgu bar gyur nas su// rang rang gnas su dengs shig gu// zhes pas gshegs su bcug go /de lta bu'i gtor ma btang bar phan yon shin tu che ste/ rgyu mtshan bar do'i sems can yid kyi lus can yin pas skad cig re la'ang 'khrul snang sna tshogs la longs spyod pa dang*/ dri'i phyir sogs phyogs kun tu rgyu ba'i sdug bsngal dang 'jigs skrag du mar longs spyod dgos pas/ de dag skyabs yul dkon mchog gi spyan sngar bkug ste/ skyabs yul rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul ba'i byin rlabs dang*/ rang res kyang phan sems byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas gtor ma sbyin zhing bar do'i 'khrul snang ngo sprad pas bar do la bar do yin par ngo shes nas/ dad pa dang dge ba'i sems kyis skye gnas ngan pa las ldog par 'gyur ba dang*/ khyad par bar do'i tshe tshad zhag bdun re yod pa'i phyed dang bzhi yan chad tshe snga ma'i snang ba 'char zhing*/ phyed dang bzhi man chad gang du skye 'gyur gyi bar do'i snang ba 'char bar gsungs te/ dper na dud 'gror skye bar 'gyur na mgo la ra zang nge ba dang*/ rkang lag rmig pa can gyi rnam par 'byung bas dud 'gror skye ba shes pa'i sdug bsngal gyis/

phal pa rnams kyang skyabs yul dkon mchog la dad pa skye ba dang dge ba'i sems la gnas pa sogs kyis skye ba bzang po len par 'gyur ba dang*/ gang zag lam la zhugs pa rnams kyang sngar gyi lta sgom sogs dge ba'i spyod pa dran pa'i mthus mngon mtho nges legs kyi lam la zin par 'gyur ba sogs phan yon dpag tu med pa 'byung bar 'gyur te/ gshin chog skabs rnam shes bkug ste bar do ngo sprod sogs dang mtshungs pas nan tan du bya'o// mkhas grub gong ma'i zhal lung mtho ris khyab// bdag blo'i bha gi ra thas ches gsal bar// bar ma'i sems can lha bu ngan song du// skye ba'i rgyu rkyen las sgrib sbyang phyir phab// rin chen snang gsal sgron ma bteg tsam gyis// stug po'i mun pa 'jig ltar dag pa 'dis// bar dor gnas pa'i 'khrul snang sdug bsngal kun// rab zhi bde ba'i go 'phang phyin gyur cig /ces mkhan chen bud+dha lak+ṣ+mīs mdzad pa'i sil gtor dang de'i gsal med mkhas btsun bkra shis dbang phyug pas mdzad pa gzhir bzhag nas/ med du mi rung ba'i kha 'gengs bcas nyams su blang bde ba'i ngag 'don rin chen gsal sgron zhes pa 'di'ang tshul rin gyis bris pa'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
